payload.title: Correlation Analysis of Toy Data and Insolation
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates the use of Pyleoclim to calculate correlations between insolation and toy data, highlighting challenges in distinguishing between seasonal and physical lag.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and define a function to correlate series with large gaps.
steps.title: Importing Libraries and Defining Functions

steps.description: Generate sinusoidal toy data for analysis.
steps.title: Creating Toy Data

steps.description: Create insolation curves for integrated July insolation at various latitudes and calculate correlations with toy data.
steps.title: Calculating Correlations with Shifted Insolation

steps.description: Calculate correlations between toy data and insolation at different months instead of different shifts.
steps.title: Calculating Correlations with Monthly Insolation

steps.description: Compile results into a multi-panel figure to visualize correlation patterns.
steps.title: Creating the Multi-Panel Figure
